title: Hornsdale Power Reserve: Phase 56J Continuation Decision
publisher: Neoen Australia via the Australian Renewable Energy Agency
summary: The operator-authored H1 2024 report states that Virtual Machine Mode had remained continuously in service since July 2022, records active and reactive response during the February 13, 2024 transmission event, and says the measured Raise 60-second response met the minimum requirement for that dispatch interval. Phase 56J decision: Retain Partially Closed. The government-hosted operator record supplies event-level observed response and a service-status statement, but it does not provide independent annual availability, complete dispatch, cycling, degradation, revenue, safety, or customer outcomes.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Event-level operation plus annual availability and dispatch under declared service denominators.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when AEMO, AER, the South Australian government, or the operator publishes a full asset-specific annual operating series with availability and dispatch denominators.
why_it_matters: The continuation decision tests a named next record against the selected denominator instead of expanding broad context or inferring performance from disclosure.
ftfn_relevance: Separates a new operating, program, or scope observation from complete closure.
Keeps evidence state separate from performance, safety, quality, readiness, value, and causation.
evidence_limits: The report is operator-authored and government-hosted, not an independent annual audit. Selected event compliance and a continuous-service statement do not establish whole-asset availability, all dispatch intervals, revenue, degradation, safety, or customer benefit.
Independent annual availability, full dispatch and service-delivery series, cycling, degradation, revenue, safety, revisions, and customer outcomes.
No causal effect, entity ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
